title: Cold-Start Cost vs Memory Reclamation: Idle-Reap Policy for the Local MLX Server
target_platform: Apple Silicon M1 (16GB Unified Memory) via Apple MLX
hypothesis: With teardown now verified (MISSION-027), reaping an idle managed MLX server after at most 5 minutes and restarting it on demand adds at most 10 seconds to the first request (p95 over 20 cold starts, boot to first generated token) with zero failed requests, while returning at least 3 GiB of the 16 GiB to the system, so an aggressive idle timeout is net-positive on a 16 GB machine.
falsification_criteria: p95 cold-start-to-first-token exceeds 10 s, or any request fails during a reap/restart cycle, or free system memory recovers by less than 3 GiB after a reap, or a reap kills a server the manager did not start.
baseline_evidence: MISSION-027 measured boot-to-ready at 1.6-2.3 s (hot cache), warm footprint 4.30-4.36 GB, and free memory recovering from about 24% to about 52% after stop; first-token latency after a cold start was not measured.

model_routing.frontier_escalation_condition: Not applicable; this mission measures local lifecycle latency.

evidence.details: 20 managed stop/start cycles ended by the real reap path on a 16 GB M1 with a human-owned server resident and swap saturated: 0 failed requests; first token median 4.0 s, p95 4.97 s, max 5.77 s (limit 10 s); 3.6 GiB resident per server; system-available memory recovered median 4.34 GiB (limit 3). Reap never touched the unmanaged :8080 server; an unmanaged decoy survived default and --only-managed reap. Default idle threshold changed 900 s -> 300 s. LIMIT: cold process with warm OS page cache, one machine and model, 2 s test threshold, 1-token requests.

lessons_learned: Measure cold starts on a separate port; never reap the human's server.
Free swap is not a limit on macOS (it grows on demand): gate on memory-free percent and disk.
Unmanaged servers report idle_sec 0.0, so default reap cannot stop them, but pass --only-managed anyway.

projected_impact.basis: Declared 2026-11-04 by claude-code (MISSION-031 backfill) from the mission's hypothesis; a mission always also edits its own manifest. Refine at checkout and confirm with `manage_coordination.py verify`. Added at close: forge_llm.py default idle timeout, chronicle, budget ledger.
